Caption side settled from PyMuPDF word coordinates against the measured bbox: the two grids print their caption ABOVE, all nine figures BELOW. rules: The paper numbers nine figures and two tables and prints every one of them with a plain 'Figure N:' / 'Table N:' caption; no exhibit anywhere carries an unnumbered caption [caption.numbering].

Caption side splits by exhibit type and is settled from word coordinates, not block order: both grids print their caption ABOVE the artwork (T1 y136 over a bbox at 147, T2 y107 over a bbox at 117) and all nine figures print theirs BELOW [caption.position].

Five headings on this paper print with the page number welded into the heading line ('2 Assumptions and Justifications 2', '5 Upgrade the Level: Vector Optimization Model 9', '6 Protocols to Measure Effectiveness 13', '7 Model Extension 15'), so a section path copied from the running head would not match any heading label; the cleaner spelling is taken from the body heading [place.section_path].

Four regions print at the top of their page above the heading that follows them (Figure 1 above section 2, Figure 2 above 4.3.4, Figure 5 above section 6, Figure 8 above section 7), so the measurer's section path names the following section and is overridden to the section the exhibit closes [place.section_path].

Not one caption carries a finite verb: every caption is a bare noun phrase ('Flow Chart of Our Work', 'Data Governance Process', 'Two Relationship Functions'), so voice is none on all eleven rows [caption.voice].

No caption states a unit, a variable, a condition or a conclusion - the paper's captions name the object and stop, and the parameters that define the artwork (the coefficient 0.2 behind Figure 2, the berth variable behind Figure 9) live in the prose, not in the caption [caption.units] [caption.variables] [caption.conditions] [caption.concludes].

Not one announcing sentence makes the exhibit its subject: eight of the eleven rows point with a locative 'shown in' / 'listed in' / 'visualized in' clause and the other three are never pointed at, so the figure-n-shows pattern is absent from the whole paper [mention.lead_pattern].

Three exhibits are never announced and never read: Figures 6, 7 and 8 sit under sections 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 that contain a heading, the plate and nothing else, so their mention count is zero, first_page is null and there is no quote to record [mention.count] [mention.first_page].

Reading sentences are just as rare: only Figure 9 is interpreted after it prints ('The diagram indicates that the two relationship functions admit the identical value at a point'), so read_sentences is 1 on exactly one row and 0 on the other ten [mention.read_sentences] [mention.trail_sentence].
Every caption prints on the same page as its artwork; no exhibit on this paper is split across a page break and no table continues [caption.position] [table.continued].

Two of the eleven exhibits are printed grids rather than plots, and they use opposite constructions: Table 1 is typeset booktabs with two rules and no verticals, Table 2 is a pasted shaded image with a full box grid, a vertical rule and per-block fills [table.rule_style] [table.zebra].

Only Table 2 merges cells (three component strips over twelve KPI rows); Table 1 has no merged cell, no diagonal header, no unit in the header and no decimal alignment - it carries no numeric column at all [table.merged_cells] [table.diagonal_header] [table.numeric_cols].
Ink families run flowchart-or-schematic 6, line 1, surface-or-3D 1, other 1; there is no bar, scatter, histogram, box, heatmap, network, map or photograph anywhere in the paper [geometry.family].

Exactly one exhibit is three-dimensional and it is the schematic one: Figure 3's oblique axes with a wireframe cube, every other plate flat, no colour bar on any of them [geometry.three_d] [geometry.colorbar].

Keys are mostly absent on this paper: seven of nine figures print no key at all, one keeps its swatch lists inside the artwork (Figure 2) and one puts its key outside at the right edge (Figure 5) [geometry.legend].

Figure 2's three panels were boxed as three separate measured regions and Figure 1's five step regions as one; the census records the row as one exhibit and excludes the two sister panels as fragment-of-other, which is why 13 measured regions yield 11 rows and 2 exclusions [geometry.panel_layout].
